title: Drugs in rheumatology as a decision: steroids and NSAIDs relieve symptoms fast but do not stop joint damage; conventional DMARDs and then biologics modify the disease; each card gives when to choose it, what to avoid and what to watch
root: Treating inflammatory arthritis · relieve it now, modify it early

groups.title: Steroids: prednisone
groups.desc: Non-specific anti-inflammatory, works rapidly. Good short term, not long term: a BRIDGE until steroid-sparing drugs start. Dose depends on the condition.

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: life- or organ-threatening: anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibody (ANCA) vasculitis · lupus nephritis · inflammatory myositis · giant cell arteritis

lines.label: Emergency:
lines.text: intravenous (IV) methylprednisolone 1 g daily × 3 days (pulse) first, e.g. giant cell arteritis with vision loss

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: flare without organ involvement · rheumatoid arthritis (RA) flare 20-40 mg, taper as the DMARD starts · polymyalgia rheumatica 15-20 mg, slow taper · acute gout 25-30 mg × 3 days, taper 5 mg every 3 days

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: chronic disease that cannot come off steroids or tolerate steroid-sparing drugs

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: only a few joints, or weight-bearing joints · fewer systemic effects

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: septic joint (wait for a negative culture) · cellulitis or psoriatic plaque over it · prosthetic joint · severe low platelets or bleeding disorder · anesthetic allergy

after.label: Avoid:
after.text: diabetes · cardiovascular disease · osteoporosis · recurrent infections · glaucoma or cataracts

after.label: Watch:
after.text: weight gain · infection · osteoporosis · avascular necrosis · high blood pressure and sugar · cataracts · proximal myopathy

groups.title: NSAIDs and analgesics
groups.desc: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) relieve pain and swelling, but are NOT disease-modifying: they do not stop RA progressing or delay erosions.

drugs.name: Non-selective NSAIDs
drugs.moa: Reversibly block cyclooxygenase (COX)-1 and COX-2 → ↓ prostaglandins. Efficacy similar: try another if one fails.

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: osteoarthritis · RA · psoriatic arthritis · ankylosing spondylitis · acute gout · pseudogout

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: cardiovascular, gastrointestinal (GI) or renal disease · anticoagulants · 3rd trimester (closes the ductus arteriosus)

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: hypertension, myocardial infarction, stroke · gastritis, peptic ulcer · renal insufficiency

drugs.name: COX-2 selective: celecoxib
drugs.moa: Spares the COX-1 prostaglandins that protect the stomach.

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: an NSAID is needed but GI risk is a worry: LESS GI toxicity

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: otherwise the same risks

lines.label: Choose when:
lines.text: osteoarthritis · mechanical back pain · regional pain

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: liver disease: max 2 g a day. Otherwise minimal side effects

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: hardly ever used: they do not treat inflammation · cognition, constipation, dependence, misuse

groups.title: Conventional DMARDs
groups.desc: Disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs) prevent joint damage. Treat EARLY (within 3 months), AGGRESSIVELY (triple therapy beats one drug) and to TARGET (remission), adjusting every 3-6 months.

drugs.name: Methotrexate
drugs.agents: 20-25 mg by mouth or subcutaneous, WEEKLY

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: GI · liver · marrow · infection · acute pneumonitis · mouth ulcers, hair loss

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: pregnancy · alcohol · sulfa antibiotics. Give folic acid 5 mg weekly

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: retinal toxicity (rare): ANNUAL EYE EXAM · no myelosuppression

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: headache · GI · liver · marrow (aplastic anemia) · reversible oligospermia

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: sulfa allergy. Screen for G6PD deficiency

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: HYPERTENSION (check at baseline) · GI · liver · marrow · neuropathy · pneumonitis

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: pregnancy (cholestyramine washout) · alcohol

after.label: Incomplete response:
after.text: methotrexate by mouth → subcutaneous · add leflunomide · add a biologic

groups.title: Biologics
groups.desc: Disease-modifying too, but TARGETED at one molecule or cell. Expensive (~$10-20,000 a year), so usually after other DMARDs fail.

drugs.name: Tumour necrosis factor (TNF) inhibitors
drugs.agents: adalimumab, etanercept (decoy receptor), infliximab (IV), golimumab, certolizumab

lines.label: Avoid:
lines.text: active, recent or recurrent infection · heart failure class III-IV · active cancer · multiple sclerosis or a family history of it

lines.label: Watch:
lines.text: infections incl. tuberculosis · demyelination · worse heart failure · skin cancer · drug-induced lupus

lines.label: Hold:
lines.text: fever · infection · antibiotics · upcoming surgery
